text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking with Machikane Tannhauser,
an unexpected voice caught my ear.
Mmmmm... Inexperienced!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was that voice...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I knew it, Chairwoman! What are you doing out here all by yourself~?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Having some rare private time today...
I decided to head out to the amusement park, but—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Lapse of memory! There are numerous attractions that require a guardian present to ride!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I expanded my grand strategy just for today,
yet to retreat in vain like this... How utterly vexing!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... Trainer!
Sounds like a job for the rescue duo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Chairwoman! Don't worry!
You have a guardian right here, don't you?!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: What!? You are willing to accompany me!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Many thanks! I will gladly accept your generosity!
Now then, time to challenge the amusement park rides again!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what deep emotion!
The very scene I've dreamed of
is spreading out right before my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: No time to waste! First off... the classic move! Straight to the roller coaster!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu. Looking at her like this,
the Chairwoman seems just like an ordinary child.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Reminds me of my little brother when he was young.
...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "...I've decided! For today, I'm going to be the Chairwoman's big sister!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"You're always taking care of me, after all!
Big Sis Machitan will look after you extra well
so you can enjoy yourself to the absolute fullest!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I've been a big sister ever since my little brother 
was born, so I'm practically a veteran at this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Chairwoman, Chairwoman!
Which ride should we go on next?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm! Since we've had gentle attractions so far
with the Ferris wheel and the teacups,
I intend to challenge the free fall next!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Then big sis... I mean, I will be your guide~!
If I remember right, take a left from here—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Doubt! According to that map over there,
isn't the Free Fall on the right path?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Oh, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! Look over there!
It's a special carrot soft serve!
You want some, right, Chairwoman!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, fascinating!
Taste test! That's the only way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, right, right?! Okay, I'll go buy it for you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, DAAAHHH~~!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A fall!? ...A nosebleed!
Use this tissue immediately!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Complete satisfaction! Truly, thanks to you two,
it was a marvelous day off!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
By the way... Tannhauser! Truly,
it's wonderful that you're so bright and energetic!
I had a lovely time thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... it's really nothing special.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"However... I am still a bit worried!
Please take utmost care of yourself and lead a healthy academy life!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, farewell!
I shall never forget today's memories!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, whaaa!?
They're actually worried about me!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...! Today, of all days,
I was supposed to be the reliable big sister
for Chairwoman Akikawa...!
choice_data_list: You were acting like a proper big sister back there.
You were acting like a proper big sister back there.
If anything, it's the other way around...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I knew it! With over ten years of experience
as a big sister, there's no way I could've failed
at being one! No way at all~... Ehehe.
choice_data_list: ...Maybe I couldn't pull it off after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hauu?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-Which one is it~?! Jeez~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Becoming a "dependable big sister"
seems like it's still a long way off.
...Unless we're talking about an "airheaded big sister," that is.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? No way...!
M-My pride as an active big sister is...!
choice_data_list: Still, the Chairwoman seemed to enjoy it.
Still, the Chairwoman seemed to enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ! You're right! That's the most important thing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "I had a lot of fun as well. I hope the three of us have a chance to hang out together again~."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"And when that time comes... I will definitely
show you that I can be a reliable big sister!"
